_description: Canonical SIMD route ledger for fgf 3.0.2. Schema v2: ISA facts consolidated top-level; work rules reference them. Edited by hand; checked by benches/simd_ledger.py.

binary-flat-sub8._no_fieldbuffer: only BinaryRepr<8> gets FieldBuffer; sub-8-degree rows lack FieldBuffer and cannot appear in byte-buffer ops
binary-flat-sub8.reason: sub-8-degree BinaryRepr lacks FieldBuffer; excluded from byte-buffer bulk operations

spec.name: custom GF(2^8) via Packed<u8>

spec.name: custom GF(2^16) via Packed<u16>
spec._note: t^2 + 2*t + 0x80 over the Reed-Solomon byte field; Relation::from_binary_words(&[0x80, 0x2])

spec.name: custom GF(2^32) via Packed<u32>
spec._note: t^2 + t + 0x2001 over the Rijndael GF(2^16) row; Relation::from_binary_words(&[0x2001, 0x0001])

spec.name: custom GF(2^64) via Packed<u64>
spec._note: t^2 + t + 0x2ada_7f36 over the Rijndael GF(2^32) row; Relation::from_binary_words(&[0x2ada_7f36, 0x0000_0001])

packed-padded.reason: PackedPadded presentation is non-bulk; no FieldKernels dispatch path

map-frobenius-quadratic.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/frobenius.rs:122 — Vieta conjugation via quadratic::conjugation_shape; power=8 mod 16=8, base_degree=8, 8/8=1 odd → Conjugation

map-frobenius-binary-column.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/frobenius.rs:203 — CompiledMap::BinaryColumns for char 2 non-Vieta; degree 8 flat, no quadratic extension → compile_columns

map-frobenius-residue-column.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/frobenius.rs:221 — CompiledMap::ResidueColumns for odd characteristic; cubic extension degree>1, power=1 normalizes to 1≠0, no quadratic conjugation → compile_columns
map-frobenius-residue-column._note: odd-characteristic cubic GF(7^3) has degree>1 and no quadratic conjugation; Frobenius::new(1) compiles columns

spec.name: frob-residue-col
spec._note: GF(7^3) as x^3 - 2; Relation::from_coordinates(&[5, 0, 0])

map-embed-injection.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:395 — is_identity_prefix → PreparedArm::Injection; AES8 is tower base of Rijndael16, structural inclusion maps generator to low component

map-embed-injection-images.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:395 — PreparedEmbedding::new from Embedding::from_images with structural images; is_structural_images=true → Injection
map-embed-injection-images._note: caller images equal the structural tower-base image of the AES generator (raw 0x2), so the compiled columns are the identity prefix

map-embed-binary-column.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:398 — PreparedArm::BinaryColumns for char 2 non-injection; Embedding::from_images with non-structural images (distinct tower base → distinct presentation) skips is_identity_prefix
map-embed-binary-column._note: AES8 and the Rijndael16 row both implement FieldBuffer; the caller image is the squared tower-base generator, a non-structural root of 0x11B that fails the identity prefix

map-embed-residue-column.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:420 — PreparedArm::ResidueColumns for odd char non-injection; the degree-2 source GF(9) injects into the degree-4 GF(81) target through a non-structural image
map-embed-residue-column._note: GF(9) as t^2 + 2t + 2 embeds in GF(81) as x^4 + 2x^2 + 2 through an element of trace-zero order; the caller image is not the structural image, so the compiled columns are ResidueColumns

spec.name: emb-residue-col-target
spec._note: GF(81) as x^4 + 2x^2 + 2; the image is the element with prime coordinates [0, 0, 1, 0], a root of t^2 + 2t + 2

map-iso-binary-column.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:398 — compile_iso then compile; BinaryColumns for char 2 non-injection; distinct presentations of same degree, no structural match → compiled columns

map-iso-binary-column-images.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:398 — PreparedIsomorphism::new from Isomorphism::from_images with non-structural images; same-degree char 2, non-injection → BinaryColumns

map-iso-residue-column.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:420 — PreparedIsomorphism::new from Isomorphism::from_images; odd char same-degree non-injection → ResidueColumns
map-iso-residue-column._note: GF(9) as a^2 + 1 mapped to itself by the Frobenius image of the generator (raw coordinate pair [0, 2]); the non-identity automorphism fails the identity prefix

spec.name: iso-residue-col-field
spec._note: GF(9) as a^2 + 1; Relation::from_coordinates(&[1, 0])

map-iso-injection.arm_citation: src/field/embedding/prepared.rs:865 — compile_iso returns Injection when the compiled columns are the identity prefix; an identity presentation supplies that prefix

row-mul-add.justification: two-element streaming window: 2 source lanes minus 2 boundary elements; floor/ceil per unit width handled by generator

row-mul-assign.justification: in-place scale; one lane of streaming overhead per direction

row-add.justification: byte-level add; one streaming lane boundary each end

row-sub.justification: byte-level sub; same streaming shape as add

matrix-mul-add.justification: matrix apply; per-row streaming same as single row

elementwise-mul.justification: elementwise multiply; one lane boundary each direction

elementwise-div.justification: division uses multiplication substage with Division scope

elementwise-inv.justification: elementwise inverse; same lane boundary shape

pack.justification: canonicalizing pack; output units are bytes, basis Target for width-changing

unpack.justification: canonicalizing unpack; input units are bytes

unit-accumulate.justification: unit-coefficient accumulate; one add per One slot

bits-and.justification: bitwise AND; lane width in bytes, generator converts to bits (*8)

bits-andnot.justification: bitwise AND-NOT; same lane shape as AND

bits-xor.justification: bitwise XOR; generator converts lane bytes to bits

bits-xor-gather.justification: gather XOR; one budget per selected source row

bits-dot.justification: bit dot product; same as xor

map-words.justification: map column fold; generator converts lane bytes to words (/8)
